_comment: Copy to credentials.json and edit. NEVER put a password in this file.
Each account names an environment variable in 'password_env'; imap_download.py
reads the password from the environment at run time.
imap_server / imap_port are optional. Omit them for a well-known provider
and imap_download.py will look the endpoint up from the address domain;
set them explicitly for a custom or workplace domain (for example a
university on Google Workspace: imap.gmail.com, or on Microsoft 365:
Most providers require an app-specific password rather than the account
password once two-factor authentication is on.
